items.title: 2.2 Basic Python Syntax and Structure (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: topic 2.2 with Python comments (PDF 35).

blocks.text: Neeche wala chhota sa Python program dikhata hai ke yeh language kitni saada aur parhne mein aasan hai:

Is misaal mein print function double quotes (" ") ke andar likha paighaam screen par dikhata (output karta) hai. Is se pata chalta hai ke Python ka syntax kitna seedha hai: print jaise functions kaam karte hain, jaise text dikhana.

Comments woh lines hain jinhein Python interpreter chalata nahi. Yeh code ke baare mein wazahat ya notes likhne ke liye hoti hain. Single-line comment # nishan se shuru hota hai. Multi-line comment ke shuru aur aakhir mein teen quotes (''') lagaye jate hain, jaise neeche hai.

# This is a single - line comment
print ( "K2 is the second-highest mountain in the world " )
'''
This is a multi-line comment.
It can span multiple lines.
'''
print ("Edhi Foundation operates the world's largest volunteer ambulance network." )

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Program chalane par sirf do lines nazar aati hain: "K2 is the second-highest mountain in the world " aur "Edhi Foundation operates the world's largest volunteer ambulance network." # wali line aur ''' ke darmiyan wali lines chalti nahi. (Kitab mein doosri print line box ki chaurai ki wajah se do lines mein toot gayi hai; Python mein string ek hi line mein likhni hoti hai.)

blocks.explanation: Yeh di gayi text ya qeematein screen par dikhata (output karta) hai.

blocks.prompt: Python code mein comments ka maqsad samjhaiye (short question 1).
blocks.explanation: Comments batate hain ke code kya karta hai aur kyun, programmer aur baad mein parhne wale ke liye; Python program chalate waqt inhein nazar-andaz karti hai, to yeh rawayya nahi badalte.

items: print() screen par paighaam dikhata hai.
Comments chalte nahi: # se single-line, ''' ... ''' se multi-line.
